Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১) Find the number of shares that can be bought for tk. 8200 if the market value is tk. 20 each with brokerage being 2.5%.
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Cost of each share = (20 + 2.5% of 20) = tk.20.5
Therefore, number of shares = 8200/20.5 = 400

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২) A merchant marks his goods 40% above the cost price and sell them at a discount of 15%. Find his gain % = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Let the cost price = 100 units
Marked price = 140 units
Selling price = 140 × 85/100 = 119
Profit % = 19/100×100 = 19%

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৩) In order to obtain an income of tk. 650 from 10% stock at tk. 96, one must make an investment of:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
To obtain tk. 10, investment = tk. 96.
To obtain tk. 650, investment = tk.96/10 x 650= tk. 6240.

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৪) While selling a watch, a shopkeeper gives a discount of 5%. If he gives a discount of 6%, he earns Tk. 15 less as profit, what is the marked price of the watch = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Let the marked price = 100x
Shop Keeper gives 5% discount, therefore, Price becomes = 95x
Again if shopkeeper gives 6% discount then the price become = 94x
According to the question if he gives 6% discount his earning will Tk.15 less
∴ 95x - 94x = 15
⇒ x = 15
∴ Marked price = 100 × 15 = Tk. 1500

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৫) A company pays 12.5% dividend to its investors. If an investor buys tk.50 shares and gets 25% on investment, at what price did the investor buy the shares?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Dividend on 1 share = (12.5 x 50)/100 = tk.6.25
tk.25 is income on an investment of tk.100
tk.6.25 is income on an investment of tk. (6.25 x 100)/25 = tk.25

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৬) A single discount equivalent to discount series 20%, 20% and 10% is = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Single equivalent discount for 20% and 20%
= 20+20−20 × 20/100 
= 40−4 = 36%
Single equivalent discount for 36% and 10%
= 36+10−36 × 10/100
= 46−3.6 =42.4%

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৭) A man buys tk. 20 shares paying 9% dividend. The man wants to have an interest of 12% on his money. The market value of each share is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Dividend on tk. 20 = tk.9/100x 20= 9/5
tk.12 is an income on tk.100.
Tk. 9/5 is an income on tk. 100/12 x 9/5 = tk.15

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৮) The B.D. and T.D. on a certain sum is Tk. 200 and Tk. 100 respectively. Find out the sum.
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
F = (BD×TD)/(BD−TD)
= (200 × 100)/ (200−100)
= 200−100/ 100
= Tk.200

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৯) A man invested Tk. 4455 in Tk. 10 shares quoted at Tk. 8.25. If the rate of dividend be 12%, his annual income is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Number of shares =4455/8.25= 540.
Face value = tk. (540 x 10) = tk. 5400.
Annual income = tk.12/100x 5400= tk. 648.

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১০) What is the banker’s discount, if the true discount on a bill of Tk. 840 is Tk.105?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Present Worth (P.W.) = 840 - 105 
= Tk. 735
Therefore, S.I. on Tk. 735 = Tk. 105
S.I. on Tk. 8400
= 105 × 840/735
= Tk. 120

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১১) The single discount equivalent to two successive discount of 20% and 5% is = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Two successive discount is equivalent
= 20+5− 20×5/100
= 25−1 = 24%

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১২) The bankers discount on Tk. 1800 at 12% per annum is equal to the true discount on Tk 1872 for the same time at the same rate. Find the time.
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
S.I. on Tk. 1800 = T.D. on Tk. 1872
P.W. of Tk. 1872 is Tk. 1800
Tk. 72 is S.I. on Tk. 1800 at 12%
Time = (100×72)/(12×1800)
= 1/3 years = 4months

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১৩) The cost price of a Tk 100 stock at 4 discount, when brokerage is 1/4% is:
১৪) The banker's gain on a bill due 1 year hence at 12% per annum is Tk. 6. The true discount is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
T.D. = (B.G.×100)/(R×T)
= Tk.(6×100 / 12×1)
= Tk.50

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১৫) A person paid Tk. 17000 for a motor-car after a single discount of 15%. If he is given successive discount of 5% and 10% then how much he would pay?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Cost price of motor-car = Tk. 17000
Mark price of motor-car
= Tk 17000 × 100/85 = Tk. 20000
After successive discount,Cost price
= Tk. 20000 × 95/100×90/100
= Tk. 17100

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১৬) The bankers discount and true discount on a sum of money due 8 months hence are Tk.120 & Tk.110 resp. Find the sum.
১৭) The market value of a 10.5% stock, in which an income of tk. 756 is derived by investing tk. 9000, brokerage being 1/4% is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
For an income of Tk. 756, investment = Tk. 9000.
For an income of Tk.21/2, investment = tk. 9000/756 x 21/2 = Tk. 125.
For a Tk. 100 stock, investment = Tk. 125.
Market value of Tk. 100 stock = Tk.125 - 1/4 = Tk. 124.75

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১৮) The true discount on a bill of Tk. 540 is Tk. 90. The banker's discount is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
P.W. = Tk.(540−90) = Tk.450
∴S.I. on Tk.450
= Tk. 90 
S.I.on Tk. 540
= Tk.(90/450×540)
= Tk.108
∴B.D.= Tk.108

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ১৯) A shopkeeper marks his goods 30% above his cost price but allows a discount of 10% at the time of sale. His gain is = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Let the cost price of goods = Tk. 100
Mark price of goods = Tk.130 (30% discount)
Selling price of goods 
= 90% of 130 = Tk 117
Gain = 117 - 100 = Tk. 17
Gain% = 17/100×100 = 17%

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২০) The banker's discount of a certain sum of money is Tk. 72 and the true discount on the same sum for the same time is Tk. 60. The sum due is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
(B.D.×T.D)/(B.D.−T.D)
= Tk (72×60/ 72−60)
= Tk. (72×60/12)
= Tk.360

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২১) A man invested tk.1552 in a stock at 97 to obtain an income of tk. 128. The dividend from the stock is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
By investing tk. 1552, income = tk. 128.
By investing tk. 97, income = tk.128/1552 x 97= tk. 8.
Dividend = 8%

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২২) A man buys tk. 50 shares in a company which pays 10% dividend. If the man gets 12.5% on his investment, at what price did he buy the shares?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:

Tk. 5 is an income on an investment of :
= Tk. (100× 2/25 ×5)

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২৩) The banker's gain on a sum due 3 years hence at 12% per annum is Tk. 360. The banker's discount is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
BG = Tk. 360
T = 3 years
R = 12%
TD = (BG×100)/TR
= (360×100)/(3×12)
= Tk. 1000
BG = BD - TD
⇒ BD = BG + TD = 360 + 1000 = Tk. 1360

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২৪) A man invested Tk. 14400 in tk. 100 shares of a company at 20% premium. If the company declares 5% dividend at the end of the year, then how much does he get?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Number of shares = (14400/120) = 120
Face value = (100 × 120) = 12000
Annual income = (5/100 × 12000) = 600

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২৫) The B.D. and T.D. on a certain sum is Tk. 200 and Tk. 100 respectively. Find out the sum.
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
F = (BD×TD)/(BD−TD)
= (200×100)/(200−100)
= 200−100/ 100
= Tk. 200

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২৬) A person has deposited Tk. 13200 in a bank which pays 14% interest. He withdraws the money and invests in Tk. 100 stock at Tk. 110 which pays a dividend of 15%. How much does he gain or lose?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Income from bank = 14% of Tk. 13200 = Tk. 1848
Number of shares purchased
= Tk. (13200/110)
= Tk. 120
Income from stock
= (15% of Tk. 100) × 120
= Tk. (15 × 20)
= Tk. 1800
∴ Loss = Tk. (1848 - 1800)
= Tk. 48

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২৭) A man invested Tk. 1552 in a stock at 97 to obtain an income of Tk. 128. The dividend from the stock is:
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
By investing Tk.1552, income = Tk 128.
By investing Tk.97, income = Tk.(128 / 1552×97) = Tk 8
∴Dividend = 8%

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২৮) A trader allows two successive discounts of 30% and 15% on selling an article. If he gets Tk. 476 for that article, find its marked price = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Let, Marked price = Tk. x
∴x× 70/100 × 85/100 =476
⇒ x = 476 × 100/70 ×100/85 
⇒ x= Tk. 800

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ২৯) The marked price is 20% higher than cost price. A discount of 20% is given on the marked price. By this type of sale, there is = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp:
Let the cost price = 100 units
Marked price = 120 units
Selling price = 120 × 80/100 = 96 units
There will be loss
Loss% = 100−96 /100 × 100 = 4%

Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.question: ৩০) A fan is listed at Tk. 150 and a discount of 20% is given. Then the selling price is = ?
Stocks & Shares, True discount, Bankers.exp: Selling price = 150×80 / 100 = Tk. 120
